northStar: Gochujang is "Fermented Editorial" — an award-winning-restaurant hero, a food-magazine grid, and one loud gochujang-crimson ember on warm charcoal that reads premium in 50ms, stays effortless to read for hours, and turns tracking into collecting — never a spreadsheet.
designPrinciples: Chrome recedes, food shouts. UI is near-invisible warm-charcoal and bone; the ONE gochujang crimson (#C63A20 light / #E8542E dark) is spent only on CTAs, the wordmark ember, active states, SpiceMeter and key labels. Loud by scarcity — never a background wash, never small colored text on light paper.

Type IS the graphic. Fraunces (display serif) carries every headline, pull-quote and oversized numeral; Geist (sans) carries all UI/body/metadata; Geist Mono tabular-nums is the instrument-panel voice for every stat, timer, Scoville and count. Two families, never three.

The fallback IS the design. No raw ships. Every SmartImage stacks palette fallbackGradient + seeded generative mesh + grain BEHIND the photo, reserves its box with aspect-ratio, and onError hides the photo keeping the art. A CDN miss reveals intentional brand art, never a broken box.

Two image tiers, one warm grade. Tier-1 full-color warm-grade for the ONE focal image per screen (hero, dish hero, featured spotlight, DishCard hover); everything else is Tier-2 charcoal+ember duotone that recedes into brand. One warm grade + one grain (0.04 light / 0.06 dark) fuse 15+ Unsplash sources into one shoot.

Whitespace is load-bearing structure and asymmetry is a rule. Generous section padding controls pace like silence controls music; featured cards break the 12-col grid (7/5 splits, text overlapping image edges) and bento blocks open Explore — the deliberate anti-tracker rhythm.

Motion enriches, never gates. The hero headline, primary CTA and nav are legible and tappable at t=0 with zero JS. One signature load moment (8s Ken-Burns + staggered headline); whileInView reveals are fade + 8–16px only; prefers-reduced-motion resolves every animation to its final state instantly.

Accessibility is non-negotiable infrastructure, not polish. AA contrast on every pairing in both themes, 44px hit targets, one h1 per route, focus-visible everywhere, state never signalled by color alone, data-viz has text equivalents. The 5-second test never depends on motion, JS, or the CDN.

heroCopy.headline: Bold flavor, worth chasing.
heroCopy.subhead: The culinary discovery platform for cooks who eat with intent — find the dishes that change you, track the ones that stick, and watch your palate get braver.

sections.name: GlobalNav
sections.layout: Sticky top, 68px, translucent/transparent over hero; on scroll-past-fold → surface @82% + backdrop-blur(12px) + shadow-sm + 1px bottom border via IntersectionObserver. Left: BrandMark wordmark (ember-drop). Right: 4 nav items (Home/Explore/Kitchen/About) in Geist Mono uppercase eyebrow with ember underline-wipe on hover + solid ember underline on active, then ButtonPrimary 'Start cooking' (pill, grad-ember) + ThemeToggle. Mobile: BrandMark + hamburger → full-height charcoal drawer, staggered items, 'Start cooking' pinned bottom.
sections.content: Wordmark 'Gochujang' with the j-dot as glowing ember teardrop; nav: Home · Explore · Kitchen · About; primary CTA 'Start cooking'.
sections.motion: Ember-drop pulses once on the transparent→solid transition; underline-wipe 200ms on hover; drawer items stagger 60ms.
sections.notes: <nav aria-label='Primary'>. Skip-to-content link is the first focusable element. scroll-margin-top = 68px on focus targets so the sticky bar never obscures focus (WCAG 2.4.11).

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Full-bleed 100vw × min(100svh,900px). 3 stacked layers: BASE generative-hero-mesh (charcoal field + bottom-right ember bloom, so crimson lands in-viewport); MIDGROUND SmartImage duotone-bleeding-to-color dish, object-fit:cover, focal right-of-center leaving the left third clean; TOP grad-duotone-ink bottom scrim (lower 45%) + 6% grain. Content bottom-left, contained max-w-[60ch].
sections.content: Eyebrow (mono): 'TASTE, TURNED UP.' · KineticHeadline H1 Fraunces display-hero 'Bold flavor, worth chasing.' with 'chasing' in ember. · body-lg subhead (the finalized subhead). · ButtonPrimary 'Start cooking' (magnetic) + ButtonGhost 'Explore dishes'. · quiet all-caps line 'TRUSTED BY 40,000+ HOME COOKS'. · thin animated scroll cue.
sections.motion: Ken-Burns 1.0→1.06 over 8s + word-by-word headline reveal (90ms stagger, 24px rise). Magnetic pull on primary CTA within ~90px. Reduced-motion → static image, full text at t=0.
sections.notes: This is the LCP element: loading=eager, fetchpriority=high, <link rel=preload as=image imagesrcset>. One <h1>. Text-shadow belt on hero copy. CTA label ≥14px semibold, never tinted.

sections.name: Flavor Pulse ticker
sections.layout: Full-width 52px band, surfaceAlt + grain, infinite horizontal marquee (~40s linear), duplicated track for seamless loop.
sections.content: Mono-caps trending terms with ember-dot separators: 'GOCHUJANG GALBI · DAY-4 KIMCHI · BULDAK 5/5 · ROSÉ TTEOKBOKKI · DOENJANG FUNK · BIRRIA×SEOUL · KOJI · NURUNGJI'. Occasional item in accent.
sections.motion: Marquee pauses on hover AND focus-within AND under reduced-motion (WCAG 2.2.2). Hovered item brightens.
sections.notes: Duplicate track aria-hidden. Real items exposed once as a genuinely tabbable link list — not scrolling-text-only. Trending info must also live elsewhere.

sections.name: Featured Dish Spotlight
sections.layout: 7/5 asymmetric editorial split, image left; on mobile stacks image-over-text. Title overlaps the image's right edge on a narrow scrim wedge.
sections.content: Eyebrow 'FEATURED THIS WEEK'. H2 Fraunces 'Gochujang-Glazed Galbi Short Ribs' (고추장 갈비). Dek: 'Fire-kissed short ribs lacquered in fermented chili and grated pear.' Mini FlavorRadar teaser, SpiceMeter 3/10, meta '45 min · Medium · Seoul', text link 'Cook it →' to /dish/gochujang-galbi.
sections.motion: whileInView fade+rise 20px, radar path draws 0→1 on enter. Image inner-vignette static.
sections.notes: <section aria-labelledby>. FlavorRadar is role=img with full aria-label of axis values.

sections.name: Category Glyph Grid
sections.layout: Asymmetric grid of 7 category tiles (photo BEHIND local SVG glyph). Bento sizing — 2 large + 5 standard — not a uniform table.
sections.content: 7 categories with glyph + name + blurb: Fermented & Funky, Charred & Smoky, Noodles & Broth, Rice & Bowls, Small Plates & Banchan, Braises & Stews, Sweet Heat. Each deep-links /explore?category=<id>.
sections.motion: On hover/tap glyph draws-in/rotates slightly + shifts bone→crimson duotone; label ember underline sweep.
sections.notes: Glyph sits on top so the grid renders richly even if photos fail. Each tile is one link with an accessible name; glyph aria-hidden.

sections.name: Explore-by-flavor band
sections.layout: Contained band, centered flavor/mood chip cluster on grad-paper-sheen (light) / charcoal (dark).
sections.content: Section header 'Pick your heat.' Mood chips (tertiary CTAs): 'Fermented & Funky', 'Weeknight Fire', 'Molten', 'Chili Head', 'Low & Slow', 'Sweet Heat' — each deep-links a pre-filtered /explore.
sections.motion: Chip fills crimson with scale-pop on click; target grid reflows via Framer Motion layout on the destination.
sections.notes: Chips are <button>/link with 44px hit area. Never compete visually with the hero primary.

sections.name: Kitchen (Mise) Teaser
sections.layout: Split: left copy block, right animated tracker mock (streak flame + batch ProgressRing + Scoville gauge + 2 StatTiles) over a 30%-opacity duotone process photo.
sections.content: Eyebrow 'MEET MISE'. H2 'Tracking, but make it collecting.' Dek on reframing the tracker as identity. StatTiles '12-day streak', '3 active batches'. Text link 'View the Kitchen →' to /kitchen.
sections.motion: On hover: streak flame flickers to life, ProgressRing animates 0→current%, gauge arc 0→value 800ms with count-up.
sections.notes: All UI (ring/gauge/flame) is local SVG. ProgressRing role=progressbar w/ aria-valuetext; gauge role=img.

sections.name: Editorial Story Rail
sections.layout: Horizontal snap-scroll carousel, single-peek ~85vw cards on mobile, 3-up desktop with edge peek.
sections.content: 3 stories: 'The Slow Fire: Why Gochujang Takes a Year' (Fermentation); 'Seoul After Midnight: A Street-Food Crawl' (Travel); 'The Case for Funk: Learning to Love Doenjang' (Technique) — each with category eyebrow, Fraunces title, excerpt.
sections.motion: whileInView stagger; roving tabindex + arrow-key nav across cards.
sections.notes: Carousel is a single tab stop with arrow navigation; each card is an <article> with one titled link.

sections.name: Social Proof Band
sections.layout: Grain-textured band, 3 pull-quotes with small duotone portraits + a restrained mono press micro-row.
sections.content: Testimonials from Priya Menon (London), Daniel Okafor (Brooklyn), Sofia Duarte (food writer) — quotes verbatim from content. Press row as quiet mono wordmarks, no loud logos.
sections.notes: Pull-quotes set in Fraunces italic optical. Portraits 1:1 with duotone ring for one unified portrait system.

sections.name: Join / Newsletter CTA
sections.layout: Full-width ~360px band on grad-ember-radial (dark) / grad-paper-sheen (light) + grain.
sections.content: H2 Fraunces 'Bring your appetite. We'll bring the heat.' NewsletterForm single email input + ButtonPrimary 'Start cooking' (the crimson primary returns here — one per screen).
sections.motion: Submit → field collapses to crimson checkmark + ember burst + toast 'Welcome. Bring your appetite.'
sections.notes: Input has real <label>, errors via aria-describedby+aria-invalid, success announced via aria-live polite.

sections.name: Footer
sections.layout: Charcoal (dark ground even in light mode for anchor weight) + grain. Oversized Fraunces brand statement, category link columns (mono), sitemap, credits, ThemeToggle, ember-drop mark.
sections.content: Tagline 'Taste, turned up.' oversized. Columns: Explore categories, Site (Home/Explore/Kitchen/About), brand statement snippet, credits, theme toggle.
sections.notes: <footer> landmark. ThemeToggle is <button aria-pressed> that syncs color-scheme + theme-color meta.

sections.name: Page header
sections.layout: Compact contained header below GlobalNav.
sections.content: Eyebrow 'DISCOVER'. H1 'Explore'. Live result count (mono, e.g. '15 dishes') + view toggle mosaic/list.
sections.notes: One <h1>='Explore'. Count updates in an aria-live polite region.

sections.name: Sticky FilterBar
sections.layout: Sticky below header, surface @90% + blur, 1px bottom border. Chip rows for cuisine, flavor profile, spice/heat, technique, time, difficulty, dietary. Mobile collapses to a floating crimson filter FAB → bottom-sheet with sticky Apply/Clear all.
sections.content: FilterChips per facet; SortDropdown (Featured / Newest / Heat / Time). Active-filter chip row below with per-chip x-dismiss + 'Clear all' ghost link.
sections.motion: Toggling a chip reflows MosaicGrid via Framer Motion layout spring; chip fills crimson + scale-pop.
sections.notes: FilterChip = <button aria-pressed>, 44px hit area, active state carries icon+fill not color-alone. Filter FAB reachable, non-overlapping with back-to-top.

sections.name: Editorial mosaic grid
sections.layout: CSS masonry, 12-col logic, gap 24px (16px mobile). Featured DishCards break to 7/5 spans. SkeletonShimmer placeholders during load; infinite scroll + load-more.
sections.content: All 15 dishes as DishCards: eyebrow cuisine, Fraunces title (2-line clamp), meta 'time · difficulty · heat', SpiceMeter chip, wishlist heart, QuickLook affordance.
sections.image: explore-dishcard-* (Tier-2 duotone at rest → Tier-1 full-color+scale 1.06 on hover)
sections.motion: Card hover: image scale 1.06 under mask, lift -4px shadow-sm→md, metadata slides up 12px. whileInView stagger capped ~8 children.
sections.notes: DishCard=<article>, ONE stretched-link title anchor for the accessible name; heart/quicklook are separate buttons outside the link (no nested interactives). content-visibility:auto on offscreen rows.

sections.name: Interspersed collection bands
sections.layout: Full-bleed 21:9 duotone band every ~8 cards to break grid rhythm.
sections.content: 'Fermented & Funky' (plum-funk) and 'Weeknight Fire' (ember-radial) band titles in Fraunces on scrim, deep-linking pre-filtered views.
sections.notes: Bands are decorative navigation, not the only home for that content.

sections.name: QuickLook modal
sections.layout: Centered dialog max-w-720px, radius-modal 28px, elevated bg, shadow-lg, backdrop charcoal 60% + blur. Left duotone image, right title/SpiceMeter/stat strip/3 actions. Mobile → bottom sheet.
sections.content: Dish image, SpiceMeter, stat strip (mono), actions Open / Save / Wishlist.
sections.notes: role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby; focus-trapped; Esc + backdrop close; restore focus to trigger; background inert.

sections.name: Empty state + back-to-top
sections.layout: Illustrated SVG empty state centered when zero results; persistent back-to-top after first viewport.
sections.content: Generative glyph (empty vessel + ember drop) + 'No dishes match that combo yet.' + 'Clear all' reset nudge.
sections.notes: Never a broken photo box; back-to-top ≥44px, non-overlapping FAB.

sections.name: Immersive hero
sections.layout: Large per-dish image, bottom scrim carrying title block. 3:2 desktop / 4:5 mobile cover.
sections.content: Dish title (H1 Fraunces), cuisine/region tag, koreanName, live SpiceMeter, aggregate rating, chef byline.
sections.motion: Subtle scale on load; reduced-motion static.
sections.notes: One <h1>=dish title. LCP not deferred/animated beyond ≤1.06.

sections.name: Sticky action bar
sections.layout: Sticky below hero (or bottom bar on mobile), shadow-lg, persists on scroll.
sections.content: Cook it · Log this cook · Add to wishlist · Save · Share. One crimson primary ('Log this cook'), rest ghost.
sections.notes: All buttons 44px, aria-labels on icon-only; scroll-margin so sticky bar never obscures focus.

sections.name: At-a-glance stat strip
sections.layout: Horizontal mono stat row.
sections.content: Total time, difficulty, servings, heat band, primary flavor tags — pulled per dish (e.g. galbi: 45 min · Medium · 4 · Heat 3 · beef/grill/gochujang).
sections.notes: Geist Mono tabular-nums; heat carries word label not color-only.

sections.name: FlavorRadar
sections.layout: 6-axis hexagon on charcoal card beside/above the intro.
sections.content: Heat, umami, acidity, sweetness, funk, texture plotted per dish.
sections.notes: role=img with full aria-label of every axis value; grid vs fill ≥3:1.

sections.name: Editorial intro
sections.layout: Contained 68ch prose column.
sections.content: The dish's longDesc — the story/POV. e.g. galbi longDesc verbatim.
sections.notes: Body ≥17px, line-height 1.65–1.75, Geist (never serif for body), text-wrap:pretty, ragged-right.

sections.name: Ingredients
sections.layout: Scalable list, two-col on desktop.
sections.content: Per-dish ingredients array; servings stepper rescales quantities; pantry/substitution hints.
sections.motion: Quantity numbers tick on servings change.
sections.notes: Servings control is a labelled stepper; quantities in mono tabular-nums.

sections.name: Method
sections.layout: Numbered steps in the 68ch column with inline technique glyphs + timing chips.
sections.content: Per-dish method array as numbered steps.
sections.notes: Steps in Geist (sans), never serif.

sections.name: Fermentation/marinade callout
sections.layout: Highlighted card, shown only when fermentDays>0 or a marinade step exists.
sections.content: Timing detail (e.g. kimchi 5 days, black cod 2 days) + 'Start a batch' CTA that seeds a Kitchen Batch.
sections.motion: Ember accent pulse on the CTA.
sections.notes: CTA routes to /kitchen with prefilled Batch. Celadon 'ready' semantics referenced.

sections.name: Pairings rail
sections.layout: Horizontal rail of 3 PairingCards.
sections.content: Drink/wine/side pairings per dish.
sections.notes: Roving tabindex.

sections.name: Tasting notes
sections.layout: Community notes list + inline TastingNoteForm entry point.
sections.content: Structured notes (aroma/texture/heat/acidity/umami/balance/verdict) + 'Add your own'.
sections.notes: Form fields labelled; RatingStars = labelled radiogroup (fieldset/legend), keyboard operable.

sections.name: Related dishes + log footer
sections.layout: Same-category carousel, then a closing crimson 'Log this cook' CTA band.
sections.content: Sibling dishes as DishCards; footer reinforces the track action.
sections.motion: Card hover choreography; carousel roving tabindex.
sections.notes: Closes the discover→log funnel.

sections.name: Personalized hero header
sections.layout: ~280px header on generative gradient-mesh + grain; greeting, avatar, kitchen title/level, animated streak flame.
sections.content: 'Welcome back' greeting, avatar, kitchenTitle/level, currentStreak in mono, animated streak flame.
sections.motion: Streak flame gentle 3s flicker (frozen under reduced-motion).
sections.notes: One <h1>='Mise' (or the greeting as h1). Foreground UI all local SVG.

sections.name: Stat tiles row
sections.layout: Row of 4 StatTiles, responsive 2×2.
sections.content: Dishes cooked, cuisines explored, active batches, current spice tolerance — with trend chips.
sections.notes: Resist spreadsheet: ≥16px padding, label mono-uppercase ~12px in text-muted, value Fraunces/display ≥20px.

sections.name: Streak & activity heatmap
sections.layout: Contribution-calendar grid + weekly-goal bar.
sections.content: Cooking-days calendar, 4-step ember ramp by intensity, today ringed; weekly goal progress.
sections.notes: Rendered as <table>/labelled list with text summary ('Cooked 4 of 7 days this week, 12-day streak'); never bare color squares; tooltip date+count.

sections.name: Active Batches board
sections.layout: Grid of BatchCards, each a ProgressRing + details.
sections.content: Ferment/marinade/pickle/cure/brine batches with vessel, ingredients, ready-in countdown, 'Mark ready'/'Log note'. Celadon ring when ready.
sections.motion: Ring animates to progressPct on mount; celadon pulse once on ready.
sections.notes: ProgressRing role=progressbar aria-valuenow/min/max + aria-valuetext ('Kimchi — 3 days left, 60% complete'). Status carries icon+label not color-only.

sections.name: Recently Cooked feed
sections.layout: Reverse-chron list with inline quick tasting-note entry + duotone thumbs.
sections.content: Cook log rows: dish, date, rating, quick note affordance.
sections.notes: content-visibility:auto on long boards; row hierarchy label/value clear.

sections.name: Spice Tolerance tracker
sections.layout: Scoville gauge (270° arc) + trend sparkline + next-tier badge.
sections.content: currentLevel, scovilleBand word label, trend, next tier.
sections.motion: Arc animates 0→value 800ms, mono count-up in sync.
sections.notes: role=img aria-label; filled vs empty arc ≥3:1; heat never color-only (word band always shown).

sections.name: Wishlist / Want-to-Cook board
sections.layout: Droppable cards you can plan onto dates.
sections.content: Wishlist items with priority/reason, drag onto plan-for date (want→planned→cooked).
sections.notes: Drag has keyboard-accessible alternative (move buttons).

sections.name: Flavor Passport
sections.layout: Map/wheel of cuisines with collected stamp glyphs.
sections.content: PassportStamp seals per cuisine/region conquered, celadon ring at mastery, mono cuisine label.
sections.motion: Stamp lands with scale-spring on unlock.
sections.notes: Each stamp role=img with descriptive aria-label.

sections.name: Achievements shelf + Insights + FAB
sections.layout: AchievementBadge medallion shelf, Insights analytics panel, and a thumb-reachable quick-add FAB.
sections.content: Badges (First Ferment, Chili Head, Ten Cuisines) unlocked/in-progress; insights (most-cooked cuisine, avg rating, heat trend); FAB: log a cook / start a batch / drop a note.
sections.motion: Unlock = grad-ember-radial burst + scale spring; toast announces.
sections.notes: Empty states use illustrated SVG (kitchen-empty-state), never broken photo. Badges role=img with title+progress (state not color-only). FAB aria-label, ≥44px, bottom-right.

sections.name: Manifesto hero
sections.layout: Full-bleed generative gradient-mesh with optional 25% duotone chili macro behind Fraunces manifesto lines. Type is the hero.
sections.content: Bold POV manifesto lines from the brand story; H1 opener e.g. 'We built Gochujang for the cook who reads menus like novels.'
sections.motion: Slow drift on mesh; KineticHeadline reveal.
sections.notes: One <h1>. Type is hero, image is atmosphere; gradient text only on dark at display size.

sections.name: Origin story
sections.layout: Contained editorial column beside a Tier-1 image.
sections.content: 'Why Gochujang' — fermentation, boldness, global-and-Korean-forward taste; brandStory/namingRationale distilled to 68ch prose.
sections.notes: Prose ≤68ch, ≥17px, ragged-right.

sections.name: Editorial values trio
sections.layout: 3-col principle cards.
sections.content: The principles behind what gets featured (discovery-first, tested-not-dumped, magazine-grade art direction).
sections.notes: Cards use one corner language (20px).

sections.name: The Palette
sections.layout: Editorial band on grad-paper-sheen explaining color/flavor/design as one language.
sections.content: Brand philosophy: warm charcoal + bone + one gochujang crimson; color and flavor as the same POV.
sections.notes: Decorative; keep accent scarcity even here.

sections.name: Contributors grid
sections.layout: Grid of duotone portraits.
sections.content: Chefs/contributors (Ha-eun Sohn, Soo-a Lim, June Cho, etc.) with names/roles.
sections.notes: One unified portrait system; alt = name+role.

sections.name: Curation standards
sections.layout: Contained explainer with numbered standards.
sections.content: How dishes are tested, rated, selected — the 'hand-tested, never dumped' standard.
sections.notes: Reinforces trust before conversion.

sections.name: Press & recognition band
sections.layout: Grain-textured strip, restrained mono wordmarks.
sections.content: Quiet press marks, no loud logos.
sections.notes: Mono treatment matches Flavor Pulse voice.

sections.name: Join CTA + contact/footer
sections.layout: Newsletter band + create-Kitchen invite, then footer.
sections.content: H2 'Bring your appetite. We'll bring the heat.' + NewsletterForm + 'Start cooking' primary; contact; shared Footer.
sections.notes: Same newsletter a11y contract as Home.

componentList.name: ShareCard
componentList.purpose: Exportable, beautifully-designed card of a logged cook/batch result.

motionList: Hero load (signature): Ken-Burns image scale 1.0→1.06 over 8s (transform/opacity, GPU) + KineticHeadline word reveal (90ms stagger, 24px rise + fade, ease [0.22,1,0.36,1]). Nothing else animates on first paint; content legible at t=0.
whileInView section reveals: fade + 8–16px translate, 300–500ms, stagger 40–80ms, viewport once:true, cap ~8 simultaneous children.

Magnetic primary CTA: cursor pull within ~90px (spring stiffness 150 / damping 15) + shadow-ember→shadow-ember-lg glow bloom; pointer-only, disabled under reduced-motion, never moves out from under pointer, focus ring stays put.
Card hover choreography: image scale 1.0→1.06 under fixed mask (220ms), lift translateY -4px + shadow-sm→md, metadata slides up 12px, QuickLook affordance fades in; duotone→full-color on the image.
Sticky-nav transition: transparent→surface@82% + backdrop-blur(12px) + shadow-sm via IntersectionObserver; BrandMark ember-drop pulses once.
Flavor Pulse marquee: ~40s linear infinite, duplicated track; pauses on hover, focus-within, and reduced-motion; hovered item brightens.
Filter reflow: FilterChip toggle reflows MosaicGrid via Framer Motion layout spring; chip crimson fill + scale-pop.
Choreographed data: ProgressRings and Scoville Gauge arc from 0→value on mount (800ms) with mono count-up in sync; radar path draws 0→1 (700ms) on view.
Streak flame flicker (gentle 3s) and achievement unlock burst (grad-ember-radial flash + scale spring) with announced toast.
Link/nav ember underline-wipe left→right on hover (200ms); active nav = solid ember underline.
Newsletter submit: field collapses to crimson checkmark + ember burst + aria-live toast.
ScrollProgress: 2px crimson top bar (aria-hidden), freezes under reduced-motion. Ambient float-slow(7s)/spin-slow(34s) reserved for decorative brand art only, stopped under reduced-motion.

prefers-reduced-motion (hard gate): useReducedMotion() branches every variant to final state instantly (opacity:1, no transform); Ken-Burns, marquee, shimmer, parallax, magnetic all quiet; the 5-second test never depends on motion.
buildNotes: FONTS — RESOLVED CONFLICT: the design system is canonical over the a11y doc's 'Inter' placeholder. Install exactly two families: @fontsource-variable/fraunces (display serif) + @fontsource-variable/geist (all UI/body), and @fontsource-variable/geist-mono (data/eyebrow). --font-accent aliases Geist Mono — never introduce a third family. woff2 only, font-display:swap, preload Fraunces display + Geist regular, cap at ~3–4 weights. Verify they actually load (not Georgia/system-ui fallback).

COLOR — RESOLVED CONFLICT: use the DESIGN-SYSTEM tokens as canonical (primary #C63A20 light / #E8542E dark, accent #D9622C/#F0873F). The content file's category accents (#D6482B etc.) are used ONLY as per-category duotone highlight hues, never as the brand primary. Wire the full light+dark palette to CSS variables and Tailwind theme; re-run axe/WebAIM on the FINAL swapped values — any change re-opens every ratio.

HERO COPY — RESOLVED CONFLICT: H1 = 'Bold flavor, worth chasing.' (UX/first-impression authority for the 5-second test). 'Taste, turned up.' is the brand tagline living in the hero eyebrow and footer, NOT the H1. Hero is 100vw × min(100svh,900px), not 92vh.

Tailwind theme.extend keys to define: colors (bg, surface, surfaceAlt, elevated, text, textMuted, textSubtle, border, primary, primaryFg, secondary, secondaryFg, accent, accentFg, success, warning, danger — all as CSS-var references so theme swap is one place); fontFamily (display/sans/mono); fontSize via clamp tokens (display-hero, display-xl, h1–h3, body-lg, body, caption, eyebrow, data); borderRadius (xs 4, sm 8, md 12, lg 18, xl 26, 2xl 36, pill 999, card 20, chip 999, modal 28, glyph 14); boxShadow (xs, sm, md, lg, ember, ember-lg, inset-dark); backgroundImage (grad-ember, grad-ember-radial, grad-fallback-crimson, grad-fallback-charcoal, grad-plum-funk, grad-celadon-fresh, grad-duotone-ink, grad-paper-sheen); spacing scale (0,2,4,8,12,16,20,24,32,40,48,64,80,96,128,160,200); transitionTimingFunction (edible: cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)); keyframes (ken-burns, marquee, shimmer, flame-flicker, float-slow, spin-slow, ember-pulse).

Theme system: html gets a data-theme class + color-scheme; keep the pre-paint script in index.html so first paint honors prefers-color-scheme with no flash; ThemeToggle persists to localStorage and syncs <meta name=theme-color>. Style BOTH light and dark fully — validate every pairing in both.

SmartImage is non-negotiable infra to build FIRST: renders GradientFallback + GenerativeHeroArt mesh + GrainOverlay behind an with aspect-ratio box (zero CLS), onError hides the photo and keeps the art. Unsplash params on every URL: ?auto=format&fit=crop&w=&q=72-78&dpr=<≤2>; responsive srcset widths [400,640,800,1200,1600] + matching sizes; exactly one eager/fetchpriority=high/preloaded LCP image per route, everything else loading=lazy decoding=async.

Committed local SVG graphic layer (KB not MB, zero network dep): film-grain, generative mesh, ember-drop BrandMark, 7 CategoryGlyphs, chili SpiceMeter unit, PassportStamp seals, FlavorRadar hexagon, achievement medallions, dividers, skeleton, scroll-cue. All inline SVG so the 'highly graphic' identity renders even with images.unsplash.com fully blocked.

Semantics: one <main> per route, single <header>/<footer>, <nav aria-label='Primary'>, exactly one <h1> per page, no skipped heading levels, each major section <section aria-labelledby>. Skip-to-content link is the first focusable element (tall hero makes this essential). DishCard=<article> with one stretched-link title anchor; heart/quicklook are sibling buttons (no nested interactives).

Data-viz text equivalents: SpiceMeter/FlavorRadar/Gauge/PassportStamp are role=img with descriptive aria-label; ProgressRing role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max + aria-valuetext; StreakHeatmap is a labelled table/list with a text summary, never bare color squares. State never by color alone — add icon/weight/underline/label to active chips, spice, batch status, ratings, errors. Meter filled-vs-empty ≥3:1.

Motion in JS: use Framer Motion useReducedMotion() and branch EVERY variant to the final state instantly (not a 1ms-collapsed jank). Keep animations to transform/opacity only so INP<200ms. Marquee/hero rotation need visible pause + ≥5s/slide and must not be the only home for their info (WCAG 2.2.2).

Perf budgets: LCP<2.5s (don't animate/defer the LCP image beyond ≤1.06 scale), CLS<0.1 (aspect-ratio boxes everywhere), INP<200ms. Hero ≤200KB AVIF, grid thumb ≤60KB, above-fold image payload ≤600KB. content-visibility:auto on offscreen mosaic rows and long Kitchen boards. Test on throttled Fast-3G / 4x-CPU AND with images.unsplash.com blocked.

Focus: keep the index.css :focus-visible (2px --primary, 3px offset); dual-tone ring (primary outline + bone box-shadow halo) over photography/duotone cards so it never washes out; scroll-margin-top=nav height on focus targets; roving tabindex for chip group, carousels, RatingStars, FlavorWheel; modals trap + restore focus + background inert.

Readability: prose ≤68ch (hard 75), body ≥16px (17–18px long-form editorial), line-height 1.6 (1.65–1.75 dense), never justify, all-caps labels ≥11px with ≥0.12em tracking, Fraunces is DISPLAY-ONLY (never body/method/steps), tabular-nums on all data.

Routing: React Router with routes /, /explore, /dish/:id, /kitchen, /about; Explore reads filter query params (category, heat, mood) so mood chips and category tiles deep-link pre-filtered; Dish 'Start a batch' routes to /kitchen with a prefilled Batch.
firstImpressionChecklist: APPETITE HIT ≤50ms: a full-bleed Tier-1 warm-graded charred dish reads 'award-winning restaurant, not a tracker' before any text is parsed.
POV IN ONE LINE: H1 'Bold flavor, worth chasing.' tells a brand-new visitor what this is and who it's for in under 5 seconds, no scroll.
BRAND COLOR OWNED IN VIEWPORT 1: gochujang crimson is unmistakable via the ember bloom + 'Start cooking' CTA + wordmark ember-dot before any interaction.
NEVER BROKEN: with images.unsplash.com blocked, the fallbackGradient + generative mesh + grain render a beautiful intentional hero — no broken box, CLS<0.1.
ONE OBVIOUS NEXT STEP: exactly one crimson primary ('Start cooking') + one ghost ('Explore dishes') — no decision paralysis, one crimson button per screen.
NAV OUT OF THE WAY: ≤4 items on a translucent bar; the image dominates and the page reads confident, not cluttered.
LEGIBLE WHILE LOUD: hero copy on the bottom grad-duotone-ink scrim + text-shadow clears AA; eye-popping and effortless simultaneously.
ALIVE, NOT GIMMICKY: exactly one load motion (Ken-Burns + staggered headline); comprehension never gated, headline never delayed.
DEPTH ON SECOND GLANCE: Flavor Pulse ticker + category glyph grid + 'Trusted by 40,000+ home cooks' confirm a real curated catalog behind the beauty.
WORKS WITH NO JS / REDUCED MOTION: hero headline, CTA, nav and core copy render and read statically; the 5-second test never depends on motion, JS, or the CDN.
BOTH THEMES: the first impression lands identically in warm light (bone) and charcoal dark, accent scarcity and grain held constant.
risks: Fraunces + Geist not yet installed — tokens reference them by name and silently fall back to Georgia/system-ui, wrecking brand fidelity and causing FOUT/CLS. Install @fontsource-variable packages and preload BEFORE anything else, or the whole 'editorial' impression collapses.

Contrast landmines on the final palette: --text-subtle fails AA for light-mode body (3.12:1) and --accent (orange) is only 2.44:1 as text on light paper. If engineers reach for them as metadata/link text the a11y audit fails. Enforce: text-muted for readable metadata, accent only as fills or dark-surface text, .text-gradient only on dark at display size.

Text-on-image legibility over unpredictable Unsplash crops: a flat 55% veil is NOT enough over bright/blown-out dishes. Must use the bottom-anchored grad-duotone-ink scrim to ≤0.18 composited luminance + text-shadow belt, measured at actual text pixels — otherwise hero/card copy fails AA in the wild.

Motion-heavy scope (Ken-Burns, marquee, magnetic CTA, layout reflow, ring/gauge/radar draws, hover choreography) risks INP>200ms and jank if anything animates layout/paint. Keep strictly to transform/opacity and fully branch useReducedMotion(), or performance and the 5-second test degrade.

LCP risk: the hero is the LCP element but sits under mesh+grain+scrim layers and a Ken-Burns transform. If the image isn't eager/fetchpriority-high/preloaded and capped ≤200KB AVIF, LCP blows past 2.5s on mobile.

SmartImage/fallback is load-bearing but easy to under-build: any raw shipped without the gradient+SVG+aspect-ratio box reintroduces broken-box risk and CLS the moment the CDN is unreachable. Treat SmartImage as blocking infra, code-review every image usage against it.

Kitchen (Mise) is the differentiator but also the biggest spreadsheet-relapse risk: without ≥16px padding, Fraunces value / mono-label hierarchy, and the graphic ring/gauge/flame/stamp layer, it reverts to the exact 'boring tracker' the rebuild exists to kill.

Scope/time: 5 routes × dozens of components × two fully-styled themes × strict a11y is large. Sequence: tokens+fonts → SmartImage+graphic layer → GlobalNav/Hero/DishCard → Home → Explore → Dish → Kitchen → About, shipping the 5-second-test-critical Home hero first.

Accent-scarcity discipline can erode as more components are added; if crimson leaks into backgrounds/secondary text it stops being loud and the brand flattens. Encode the rule in review: one crimson filled button per screen, accent only on CTAs/wordmark/active/SpiceMeter/labels.

Data-viz a11y (radar/gauge/heatmap/progress rings) is frequently shipped as color-only pretty graphics; without role/aria-valuetext text equivalents and ≥3:1 filled-vs-empty they fail WCAG and are unreadable to AT and color-blind users.
